title: Present phases as concurrent workstreams with entry and exit criteria
requirements:
- Show governance, financing, capacity and other threads running across phases rather than as gates
- Describe timeframes as illustrative and explain how to estimate duration from scope and readiness
- Express each phase's intended result as entry conditions and closure criteria
- Allow urgent services to proceed in parallel with governance set-up, under minimum standards, bounded scope and a transition plan
- Require country-specific sequencing within Phase 2 based on use cases and dependencies
- Explain how commitments can survive changes in administration
- Define minimum Phase 2 acceptance criteria for a 'standards-conformant foundation'
- Divide Phase 3 into workstreams with separate milestones
